title: NASA POWER source-native-resolution hourly point data
version: POWER Hourly API v2.9.8; 2020-01-01 through 2020-01-02 UTC
publisher: NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project

doi.absence_reason: The API response does not assign a DOI to this point query.

measurement_uncertainty.description: The API response does not embed per-value uncertainty; POWER offers a separate parameter uncertainty viewer.

known_gaps: POWER combines satellite observations and assimilation/reanalysis model products.
The archive can be revised by bias corrections, model updates, and error fixes, so the raw response checksum is required.
The API defaults to Local Solar Time unless UTC is requested explicitly.
Satellite and reanalysis values are forcing-plausibility evidence rather than exact ground truth.

preprocessing.description: Select representative raw rows and record normalized fields, unit conversions, missing masks, and UTC semantics.

permitted_use.notes: NASA encourages citation; the source response contains no restrictive notice and is treated under NASA's science-data CC0 default.
